description: The LWMA difficulty adjustment and the median-time rule. timestamps[i] is block i+1's timestamp (the genesis block has timestamp 0). required_targets[i] is the target block i+1 must be BELOW, and the last entry is for the next block. median_times[i] is the earliest timestamp block i+1 may carry (when window > 0). Targets are decimal strings.
name: difficulty

scenarios.name: steady 60 s from the real start target
blocks much faster (5 s): the 4x per-block clamp
blocks very slow (10000 s): the 6x solve-time clamp
one huge gap in the middle
timestamps out of order (jitter of +-90 s)
